Sir,
With reference to the subject cited above, it ig to inform that Signal Review
Panel (SRP} of Pharmacovigilance Programme of India (PyPY concluded that there isa
strong relationship between anti-rabies vaccine and Erythema Multiforme, based on
Spontaneously received Adverse Drug Reactions (ADRs) data and published literature,
Hence, whe SRP has recommended that Erythema Multiforme needs to be inserted in
the drug safety label of Anti-Rabies vaccine, manufactured and imported in India.
Accordingly, all the Manufacturers and importers of rabies vaccine are hereby ,
er directed to ensure that Erythema Multiforme is inserted in the drug safety label of the
subject vaecine and also submit the revised Prescribing Information /Package Insert to
this Directorate for further review and approval of the same.
